library_editor_contract.label: Libraries Editor boundary
rules: Libraries Editor selections may preview or load JSON records only.
Generator, Prompt Builder and Worktree Export must not read Libraries Editor checkbox state as active routing input.
Create Export may use references and roles from its resolved Create config because that config is produced by mode, stack, target match and schema contracts.
Targets, file types, boilerplate profiles and detected project evidence activate references and operation roles through schema matching.
Strict routing is allowed only for generator-pinned or Create-config-pinned IDs, never for editor preview selection.
validation_focus: No call from Generator/Prompt/Worktree Export to _selected_reference_ids or _selected_operation_role_ids.
Libraries Editor can still preview/edit selected records without mutating target routing.
TOKENS and metadata distinguish generator-pinned IDs from editor preview state.

reference_domains.label: Libraries Editor Boundary Reference
rules: Treat hooks, weights, references and roles tabs as library editors, not prompt routing selectors.
Use Generator targets and Create config as routing authority.
Do not mirror Create routing into editor checkbox state.
guardrails: Editor-selected items are not active references by themselves.
Plugin/user entries remain data records until schema routing or target config activates them.

operation_roles.label: Libraries Editor Boundary Operator
rules: Keep editor state and generation routing separate.
Validate that Generator/Prompt builds pass generator-pinned IDs only.
Validate that Create exports use resolved Create config references/roles, not Libraries Editor checkbox state.

hooks.label: Libraries Editor Boundary Gate
rules: Reject generation paths that use Libraries Editor checkbox selections as active references or roles.
Allow editor selections only for preview/edit/load/apply operations.

weight_table.label: Libraries editor boundary standard
rules: Generator targets and Create config outrank editor UI selections.
Library editor preview state must be excluded from export routing.

weight_operators.label: Libraries Editor Boundary Weight Operator
rules: Score patches higher when routing authority is explicit and editor state stays isolated.
Score patches lower when checkboxes or preview selections leak into generation.
